more.title: Settings
more.hint: Prayer time settings. If you are not sure, the automatic options follow the most common conventions for your region.
more.notificationsHint: Get a reminder at each prayer time. Your phone's silent switch and Focus modes can mute these — that is an iPhone setting, not the app.
more.notificationsHint_android: Get a reminder at each prayer time. Do Not Disturb and your phone's volume settings can mute these — that is an Android setting, not the app.
more.exactAlarmBody: Android delays app reminders to save battery unless you allow "Alarms & reminders" for Deen Dawn. Allowing it makes the adhan arrive at the exact minute.
more.exactAlarmCaveat: Until then, reminders still arrive — they may just run a few minutes late.
more.readingSizeDesc: Text size for the Quran and translation
more.nightWarmDesc: Amber tones in the Quran reader, easier on the eyes before dawn
more.privacyNote: DeenDawn stores everything on your phone. No account, no ads, no tracking.
more.restartBody: Switching the app language needs a quick restart to change the layout direction.
more.fullAdhanHonesty: iPhones cannot play a full-length adhan from a notification. With "Full adhan", the reminder plays the short clip, and the full adhan plays when you open the app from it.
more.fullAdhanHonesty_android: With "Full adhan", the reminder plays the short clip, and the full adhan plays when you open the app from it. Android stops notification sounds if you clear the notification shade.

about.title: About
about.privacyBody: DeenDawn keeps everything on your phone. No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking. Your location is used only on this device for prayer times and the qibla, and is never transmitted. The only network use is streaming recitation audio you request.

adhanHelp.title: Adhan not playing?
adhanHelp.lead: Android phones sometimes quiet apps to save battery. These checks fix nearly every missed adhan.
adhanHelp.volumeBody: Adhan reminders play on the alarm volume. Check the alarm slider in your volume settings, and remember Do Not Disturb can silence notifications entirely.
adhanHelp.exactBody: With "Alarms & reminders" allowed, the adhan arrives at the exact minute. If the card below is visible, timing is currently inexact.
adhanHelp.batteryBody: If your phone puts Deen Dawn to sleep, reminders can stop after a few days. Find Deen Dawn in the battery optimization list and choose "Don't optimize".
adhanHelp.oemBody: Some brands add their own aggressive battery managers on top of Android:
adhanHelp.oemSamsung: Samsung — Settings → Battery → Background usage limits: make sure Deen Dawn is not in "Sleeping" or "Deep sleeping" apps.
adhanHelp.oemXiaomi: Xiaomi / Redmi — Settings → Apps → Manage apps → Deen Dawn: enable Autostart, and set Battery saver to "No restrictions".
adhanHelp.footer: Deen Dawn never asks for special exemptions itself — these are your phone's own settings, and you stay in control.
